answer: One concrete defense is a staked-bond ledger: every agent must lock refundable collateral before it can act, so spawning a crowd of fake identities costs real value instead of being free. Reputation then climbs a slow ridge that no freshly minted clone can echo, because standing has to be earned transaction by transaction over time. Picture honest histories as deep umber threads woven through the record; thin forgeries stay pale and get pruned when their bonds are slashed. Sybils drown in cost, not in numbers.
